title: Vote to release Apache Iceberg Terraform Provider v0.2.0 RC1
summary: Matt Topol (zeroshade) proposed release candidate 1 of the Apache Iceberg Terraform provider v0.2.0, based on commit 5f869f0, with a source release and convenience binaries for the Terraform and OpenTofu registries attached to a GitHub prerelease. Voters verified signatures and checksums, built the provider, ran the tests and checked the LICENSE and NOTICE files. Alex Stephen (rambleraptor) noted a licensing fix found by Matt in terraform-provider-iceberg PR #154 and hoped the candidate could still be used, since BSD-3 and Go licenses are already listed for other dependencies. Kevin Liu reported a few non-blocking license and notice nits that he would track on GitHub, and Russell Spitzer said the Roaring Bitmap license issue from that PR is not a blocker. Sung Yun also verified the convenience binaries. Matt Topol closed the vote as passed and said he would proceed with the release.

positions.stance: The candidate should go ahead despite the license fix in PR #154, since BSD-3 and Go licenses are already listed for other dependencies.
The candidate verifies, and a few license and notice nits are non-blocking and will be tracked on GitHub.
The Roaring Bitmap license issue is not a blocker for the release.

outcome.note: The vote passed with 4 binding +1 votes, 1 non-binding +1 vote and no -1 votes.

why_it_matters: The release is meant to get the provider into the Terraform Registry.
